units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 16b:22">M. Kat. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>ראה מי קורא וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. omit <cite ref="T00011"><he>ראה</he></cite>) see who calls thee outside.

<cite ref="Ketubot 64b:2">Keth. 64ᵇ</cite> <he>מי שוכר את מי</he> which hires which?, i.e. which (of the two) hires and which is hired? <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 9:1">B. Bath. IX, 1</cite> <he>מי שמת וכ׳</he> he who (if one) died and left &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 6:7">Ib. VI, 7</cite> <he>מי שהיתה דרך וכ׳</he> he through whose field there is a public passage.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 6:6">Ib. 6</cite> <he>מי שיש לו גינה וכ׳</he> he who has a garden &c.; a. v. fr.—(Chald.) <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 41b:9">Ab. Zar. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>מי יימר דבטליה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דבטלה</he>) who can say (how do we know) that he cancelled it?

senses.gloss: [who will?,] Oh that! Sot. V, 2, a. e. מי יגלה וכ׳, v. גָּלָה.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 49b:7">Pes. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>מי יתן לי ת״ח וכ׳</he> Oh that I had a scholar before me, and I would &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: [is there any?; in gen. introducing a question:] is there?, does he? &c.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 31a:3">Sabb. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>מי כאן הלל</he> does Hillel live here? <cite ref="Chullin 33a:6">Ḥull. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>מי איכא מידי וכ׳</he> is there anything which is permitted &c.

<cite ref="Chullin 32b:14">Ḥull. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>מהו מי מצטרף וכ׳</he> how is it? can the first cut be combined with the second to effect &c.? <cite ref="Nazir 32b:10">Naz. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>אילו … מי הוה נדריתון</he> if one had come … would you have vowed? <cite ref="Nazir 32b:10">Ib.</cite> <he>מי יודעין לאימתי</he> did they know when? <cite ref="Nazir 32b:6">Ib.</cite> <he>מי ידעין בהי וכ׳</he> did they know on what day?—
<cite ref="Pesachim 14b:11">Pes. 14ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מי דמי</he> (sub. <he>הא להא</he>) is there an analogy between the two cases?; v. <cite ref="D00892"><he>דְּמֵי</he> I</cite>; a. v. fr.
